sounds.prompt: A short warm two-note reward sting: a soft brass note rising to a higher bell chime that rings out and fades. Gentle, friendly, 1980s feel, dry, no reverb tail, no drums, no voice.
sounds.reason: Read from the review pictures (the takes were not listened to): take 1 shows two separate notes, a soft swell at the start and a second, brighter note at about 0.5 s with strong upper partials (the bell) that rings out to 1.24 s. Take 2 has two notes but is a flat tone cut at 0.96 s with no bell brightness; take 3 is one smeared swell with no second note; take 4 peaks at 124 ms and reads as one hit.
